write_behavior: none; commands read and emit canonical JSON only

schedule_authority.admission_rule: Consume the exact harness schedule generically without answer, tension-ID, model, route, slot, or cell-specific semantic exceptions.

external_freeze_manifest.storage_framing: Canonical minified UTF-8 JSON with exactly one terminal LF and no CR.
external_freeze_manifest.runtime_dependencies_derivation: Exact path/sha256/bytes projection of the candidate-v8 architecture_contract.json 46-row runtime_dependency_closure, sorted by path and independently reopened beneath successor_20260813.
external_freeze_manifest.closed_world_rule: The candidate directory contains exactly ten audited non-audit files plus the independent audit as the eleventh freeze candidate file. Manifest and dependency inventories are derived from current v8 bytes.

audited_candidate_bundle.canonical_aggregate_rule: canonical_rows_sha256 and canonical_rows_bytes bind canonical minified UTF-8 JSON of the exact files array only
audited_candidate_bundle.audit_rule: validate_audit requires the PASS audit's exact audited_candidate_bundle to equal the bundle recomputed from the same current ten rows used by freeze validation.
audited_candidate_bundle.manifest_rule: The external manifest carries the same full bundle before its independent audit binding.
audited_candidate_bundle.run_contract_rule: Every run contract carries the same full bundle after manifest path/hash/bytes; freeze_binding propagates it through all run evidence.

run_contract.freeze_rule: Fixed repository-relative manifest path plus current storage SHA-256/bytes and exact full audited_candidate_bundle; manifest, audit, and all inventory files are reopened before each run command.

dispatch_schedule.order: slot-alpha, slot-bravo, slot-charlie; within each slot, exact harness cell order
dispatch_schedule.uniqueness: Every nonce is unique across all 291 entries. Qualification requires the two 291-nonce sets to be disjoint.
dispatch_schedule.persistence: Externally created once before any subject call and byte-bound by run_contract plus the external prelaunch/Git checkpoint.
dispatch_schedule.mutation_failure: Every command reopens the schedule. Mutation of schedule alone fails its run-contract hash/bytes; coordinated schedule/run-contract mutation fails stored admissions, dispatch objects, and primary wrappers after any receipt.

dispatch_binding.wrapper_rule: Canonical binding JSON appears in one constant typed opaque wrapper and is explicitly semantically ignored. No expected answer, oracle, score, model, route exception, or cell-specific branch enters construction.
separate_measurements: full dispatch wrapper SHA-256 and bytes

primary_rollout_revalidation.file_rule: Exact absolute resolved path beneath the session root; lstat regular nonlink, O_NOFOLLOW open, stable fstat/read, and exact storage SHA-256/bytes.
primary_rollout_revalidation.parse_rule: UTF-8 JSONL with terminal LF, no CR or blank rows, and duplicate JSON keys rejected at every object depth.
independent_derivations: session/thread, turn, task_started, and task_complete identity
current predeclared schedule entry and schedule storage binding
exact full wrapper bytes recorded in the relevant user message
openai provider and requested model/thinking in turn context and collaboration settings
raw assistant final-message array and exact text normalization
fail-closed prohibited response-item array and types
status, timing, first attempt, fresh context, one session, and one turn

response_item_classification.valid_final_text_policy: message remains safe; existing exact final-content and idempotent byte-identical duplicate-final semantics remain unchanged.

commands.self-test: No evidence-filesystem, harness, subject, or provider call. Preserve seven replay/schedule and six response-item proofs; additionally reject all ten non-audit file mutations plus stale audit, manifest retag, row reorder/extra/missing, and run-contract mismatch.
commands.validate-freeze: Validate the fixed v8 external manifest, exact current ten-file audit bundle, PASS audit equality, eleven-file freeze inventory, and architecture-derived 46-row runtime closure.
commands.admit: Validate freeze, run contract, immutable predeclared schedule, exact next same-slot cell, deterministic prerequisites, and absence of downstream/terminal evidence.
commands.validate-cell: Independently reopen primary rollout and reconstruct dispatch, response-item, receipt, capture, render, and score evidence.
commands.qualify-two-runs: Require sequence 1 then 2, different run IDs, disjoint 291-nonce schedule sets, two clean matrices, 582 PASS calls, 582 independent rollout validations, and unique nonce/thread/turn identities.

identity_limits: Exact audited_candidate_bundle equality proves the audited subject bytes, not cryptographic auditor authorship; audit-file and repository custody remain trusted boundaries.
The verifier cannot retrospectively prove CSPRNG entropy; external creation and prelaunch/Git checkpoint receipts own that fact.

A standalone verification has no global registry of abandoned run_id/schedule pairs; external create-only run custody must prohibit reusing a full prior run identity, while two-run qualification proves disjointness for the two supplied roots.
No separate platform task_id, direct thread-create invocation receipt, provider-effective model/thinking, or serving-snapshot attestation is exposed.
The disposable session store and root-controller workflow remain trusted custody boundaries.
nonclaims: No freeze, passing audit, launch, subject/provider call, empirical model pass, qualification, production enforcement, release readiness, or safety certification is claimed.
